# BACTERIAL MENINGITIS WITH S. PNEUMONIAE

Once a diagnosis of acute bacterial meningitis is considered likely, antimicrobials should be initiated as soon as possible. Two blood cultures should be drawn. Lumbar puncture (LP) should be performed in nearly all patients to obtain cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) for establishing diagnosis and determining infectious organism/susceptibility. Adjust antimicrobial regimen to optimize therapy and treatment duration based on pathogen once isolated.

Intravenous dexamethasone therapy improves outcomes for meningitis with Streptococcus pneumoniae and is recommended for empirical treatment of all community acquired cases that might be associated with S. pneumoniae.

Dexamethasone must be given before (1 to 20 minutes) with antimicrobials.

---

# Antimicrobial Treatment

Note: Antimicrobials depend on S. pneumoniae MIC results. In most cases, results will usually be known only after 2 or 3 days of therapy.

# Duration of Therapy

Treat for a total duration of 10-14 days.

---

Therapy:
## If Initiating Therapy, Give:

Dexamethasone 10 mg IV q6h ($) for 4 days
Initial empiric antimicrobial regimen pending susceptibility test results:
Ceftriaxone 2 gm IV q12h ($) [M] <AND> vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV q12h ($) [R]
Alternative:
[Assessment of beta-lactam reaction](beta-lactam-allergy-assessment)
Meropenem 2 gm IV q8h ($$) [R,O] ] <AND> vancomycin 15mg/kg IV q12h ($) [R]

## Treatment if Penicillin MIC < or = 0.1 mcg/mL

Preferred:

Penicillin G 4 million units IV q4h ($$) R

< OR >
Ampicillin 2 gm IV q4h ($$) R

< OR >
Ceftriaxone 2 gm IV q12h ($) M

## Treatment if Penicillin MIC > or = 0.1 mcg/mL and Ceftriaxone MIC < or = 0.5 mcg/mL

Preferred:

Ceftriaxone 2 gm IV q12h ($) M

Alternative:

Assessment of beta-lactam reaction

Meropenem 2 gm IV q8h ($$) R

## Treatment if Penicillin MIC > or = 0.1 mcg/mL and Ceftriaxone MIC > 0.5 mcg/mL

Treat as listed below, and obtain another CSF specimen in 24 to 48 hours.

Preferred:

Ceftriaxone MIC < 2 mcg/mL
Ceftriaxone 2 gm IV q12h ($) M <AND> vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV q12h ($) R

Ceftriaxone MIC >/= 2 mcg/mL
< ADD > Rifampin 600 mg PO q24h to above ($) DI,O

< OR >
< ADD > Rifampin 600 mg IV q24h to above ($$$$) DI,O

Alternative:

Assessment of beta-lactam reaction

Meropenem 2 gm IV q8h ($$) [R,O] ] <AND> vancomycin 15mg/kg IV q12h ($) [R]
Inpt: ORZID2 GMENU BACT MENING S. PNEUMONIAE
